paragraphs.text: It is actually reported that there is fornication among you, and such fornication as is not even among the Gentiles, that one [of you] hath his father`s wife.
paragraphs.original: Ὅλως ἀκούεται ἐν ὑμῖν πορνεία, καὶ τοιαύτη πορνεία ἥτις οὐδὲ ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν, ὥστε γυναῖκά τινα τοῦ πατρὸς ἔχειν.
paragraphs.translit: Holōs akouetai en hymin porneia, kai toiautē porneia hētis oude en tois ethnesin, hōste gynaika tina tou patros echein.

paragraphs.text: And ye are puffed up, and did not rather mourn, that he that had done this deed might be taken away from among you.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ὑμεῖς πεφυσιωμένοι ἐστέ, καὶ οὐχὶ μᾶλλον ἐπενθήσατε, ἵνα ἀρθῇ ἐκ μέσου ὑμῶν ὁ τὸ ἔργον τοῦτο ποιήσας;
paragraphs.translit: kai hymeis pephysiōmenoi este, kai ouchi mallon epenthēsate, hina arthē ek mesou hymōn ho to ergon touto poiēsas;

paragraphs.text: For I verily, being absent in body but present in spirit, have already as though I were present judged him that hath so wrought this thing,
paragraphs.original: Ἐγὼ μὲν γάρ, ἀπὼν τῷ σώματι παρὼν δὲ τῷ πνεύματι, ἤδη κέκρικα ὡς παρὼν τὸν οὕτως τοῦτο κατεργασάμενον
paragraphs.translit: Egō men gar, apōn tō sōmati parōn de tō pneumati, ēdē kekrika hōs parōn ton houtōs touto katergasamenon

paragraphs.text: in the name of our Lord Jesus, ye being gathered together, and my spirit, with the power of our Lord Jesus,
paragraphs.original: ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ, συναχθέντων ὑμῶν καὶ τοῦ ἐμοῦ πνεύματος σὺν τῇ δυνάμει τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ,
paragraphs.translit: en tō onomati tou kyriou hēmōn Iēsou, synachthentōn hymōn kai tou emou pneumatos syn tē dynamei tou kyriou hēmōn Iēsou,

paragraphs.text: to deliver such a one unto Satan for the destruction of the flesh, that the spirit may be saved in the day of the Lord Jesus.
paragraphs.original: παραδοῦναι τὸν τοιοῦτον τῷ Σατανᾷ εἰς ὄλεθρον τῆς σαρκός, ἵνα τὸ πνεῦμα σωθῇ ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τοῦ κυρίου.
paragraphs.translit: paradounai ton toiouton tō Satana eis olethron tēs sarkos, hina to pneuma sōthē en tē hēmera tou kyriou.

paragraphs.text: Your glorying is not good. Know ye not that a little leaven leaveneth the whole lump?
paragraphs.original: Οὐ καλὸν τὸ καύχημα ὑμῶν. οὐκ οἴδατε ὅτι μικρὰ ζύμη ὅλον τὸ φύραμα ζυμοῖ;
paragraphs.translit: Ou kalon to kauchēma hymōn. ouk oidate hoti mikra zymē holon to phyrama zymoi;

paragraphs.text: Purge out the old leaven, that ye may be a new lump, even as ye are unleavened. For our passover also hath been sacrificed, [even] Christ:
paragraphs.original: ἐκκαθάρατε τὴν παλαιὰν ζύμην, ἵνα ἦτε νέον φύραμα, καθώς ἐστε ἄζυμοι. καὶ γὰρ τὸ πάσχα ἡμῶν ἐτύθη Χριστός·
paragraphs.translit: ekkatharate tēn palaian zymēn, hina ēte neon phyrama, kathōs este azymoi. kai gar to pascha hēmōn etythē Christos·

paragraphs.text: wherefore let us keep the feast, not with old leaven, neither with the leaven of malice and wickedness, but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth.
paragraphs.original: ὥστε ἑορτάζωμεν, μὴ ἐν ζύμῃ παλαιᾷ μηδὲ ἐν ζύμῃ κακίας καὶ πονηρίας, ἀλλʼ ἐν ἀζύμοις εἰλικρινείας καὶ ἀληθείας.
paragraphs.translit: hōste heortazōmen, mē en zymē palaia mēde en zymē kakias kai ponērias, allʼ en azymois eilikrineias kai alētheias.

paragraphs.text: I wrote unto you in my epistle to have no company with fornicators;
paragraphs.original: Ἔγραψα ὑμῖν ἐν τῇ ἐπιστολῇ μὴ συναναμίγνυσθαι πόρνοις,
paragraphs.translit: Egrapsa hymin en tē epistolē mē synanamignysthai pornois,

paragraphs.text: not at all [meaning] with the fornicators of this world, or with the covetous and extortioners, or with idolaters; for then must ye needs go out of the world:
paragraphs.original: οὐ πάντως τοῖς πόρνοις τοῦ κόσμου τούτου ἢ τοῖς πλεονέκταις καὶ ἅρπαξιν ἢ εἰδωλολάτραις, ἐπεὶ ὠφείλετε ἄρα ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου ἐξελθεῖν.
paragraphs.translit: ou pantōs tois pornois tou kosmou toutou ē tois pleonektais kai harpaxin ē eidōlolatrais, epei ōpheilete ara ek tou kosmou exelthein.

paragraphs.text: but as it is, I wrote unto you not to keep company, if any man that is named a brother be a fornicator, or covetous, or an idolater, or a reviler, or a drunkard, or an extortioner; with such a one no, not to eat.
paragraphs.original: νῦν δὲ ἔγραψα ὑμῖν μὴ συναναμίγνυσθαι ἐάν τις ἀδελφὸς ὀνομαζόμενος ᾖ πόρνος ἢ πλεονέκτης ἢ εἰδωλολάτρης ἢ λοίδορος ἢ μέθυσος ἢ ἅρπαξ, τῷ τοιούτῳ μηδὲ συνεσθίειν.
paragraphs.translit: nyn de egrapsa hymin mē synanamignysthai ean tis adelphos onomazomenos ē pornos ē pleonektēs ē eidōlolatrēs ē loidoros ē methysos ē harpax, tō toioutō mēde synesthiein.

paragraphs.text: For what have I to do with judging them that are without? Do not ye judge them that are within?
paragraphs.original: τί γάρ μοι τοὺς ἔξω κρίνειν; οὐχὶ τοὺς ἔσω ὑμεῖς κρίνετε,
paragraphs.translit: ti gar moi tous exō krinein; ouchi tous esō hymeis krinete,

paragraphs.text: But them that are without God judgeth. Put away the wicked man from among yourselves.
paragraphs.original: τοὺς δὲ ἔξω ὁ θεὸς κρίνει; ἐξάρατε τὸν πονηρὸν ἐξ ὑμῶν αὐτῶν.
paragraphs.translit: tous de exō ho theos krinei; exarate ton ponēron ex hymōn autōn.
